free_tier.stated: No free tier — three paid plans: 'S | 200 GiB | $0.027/hour | ~$19.71/month', 'M | 600 GiB | $0.0613/hour | ~$44.749/month', 'L | 5 TiB | $0.291/hour | ~$212.43/month'.
free_tier.notes: plans are billed by the hour actually used; the monthly figure is the hourly price x 730 hours

egress.terms: Egress is genuinely unlimited and free — 'Traffic is unlimited, no matter what its destination' and 'Inbound/outbound traffic and maintenance are also included in the price' — but the storage is a flat monthly subscription, so the free-egress advantage is unusable without paying.

tooling: Harbor API + docker/skopeo/ORAS; Harbor's own replication for chaining registries.
chaining: None free. The $200 trial credit is a trial, not a free tier.

limits.value: 200 GiB on plan S, 600 GiB on plan M, 5 TiB on plan L, per registry

limits_note: 15 concurrent connections on plan S, 45 on M and 90 on L (3, 9 and 18 clients at 5 connections each)

identity_cost.detail: an email address validated by a one-time code, the country of tax residence, and a valid payment method on the account before the first Public Cloud project; Visa, Mastercard and Maestro cards are accepted, and PayPal and a prepaid account are offered as payment methods

reliability_note: 99.9% availability SLA on plan S; on plans M and L, 99.9% in a 1-AZ region and 99.99% in a 3-AZ region
confidence_note: documented: the international price list, the Managed Private Registry page, the account-creation guide and the free-trial page were read and quoted on 2026-10-30; a pull timed from a registry would make it measured
